prose: Natura unveils Interface, a $99 smart ring meant as an interface to AI agents. It tracks heart rate, HRV, sleep and activity like a health ring, and at launch connects to agents and apps including Meta's Muse, Instinct, Grokbot, Claude and ChatGPT.

Founder Carlo Edoardo Ferraris, who earlier made HumanPods earbuds, says people want access to agents all day and that a ring is the right form. Pre-orders are expected next month, shipping in December or January.
highlights: $99 smart ring that talks to AI agents
Also tracks heart rate, HRV, sleep and activity
Connects to Muse, Instinct, Grokbot, Claude, ChatGPT and more
From Natura, maker of HumanPods earbuds
Pre-orders next month, shipping December or January
